newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japanese March net foreign bond buying 393 bln yen.
newsitem.headline: Japanese March net foreign bond buying 393 bln yen.

text.p: Net purchases of foreign bonds by Japanese investors totalled 393.0 billion yen in March after net sales of 450.0 billion yen a month earlier, the Ministry of Finance said on Wednesday.
Bonds include beneficiary certificates but exclude all bills.
Net buying of Japanese stocks by foreign investors amounted to 558.7 billion yen in March compared with net purchases of 411.0 billion yen the previous month, the ministry said.
Details of Japanese and foreigners' investments in billions of yen, were as follows:
Foreign stocks: Net Foreign bonds: Net
Japanese stocks: Net Japanese bonds: Net
Figures are rounded and based on settlements.
